en: Stronger Password Rules: Passwords now require at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character. Live strength feedback and breached-password verification are now active.
Duplicate Vendor & Non-PKP Fix: Non-PKP vendors using tax ID placeholders (such as 'No PPN', 'NON PKP', '-') are now handled smoothly without duplicate registration conflicts.
File Upload Verification: Robust document inspection and magic-byte validation now safeguard all uploaded files (PDF, Word, Excel, and images).
id: Aturan Kata Sandi Lebih Kuat: Kata sandi kini memerlukan minimal 12 karakter (huruf besar, kecil, angka, dan karakter khusus) disertai indikator kekuatan langsung dan deteksi kebocoran kata sandi.
Perbaikan Vendor & Non-PKP: Vendor non-PKP yang memasukkan nomor pajak pengganti (seperti 'No PPN', 'NON PKP', '-') kini dapat mendaftar tanpa kendala duplikasi.
Pemeriksaan Unggah Berkas: Pengecekan mendalam dokumen dan validasi magic-byte berkas kini melindungi seluruh dokumen unggahan (PDF, Word, Excel, dan gambar).
